data.exact_reserve_text: Change in prior year provisions Gross (5,243) Reinsurance (728) Net (5,971)
data.standardized_narrative: For the year ended 31 December 2015, SIMA Syndicate 1945 reported a gross prior year reserve release of GBP 5.243 million, representing a 15.64% reduction of its opening gross claims outstanding. This favourable development was predominantly in respect of Accident & Health business. The Syndicate applies a margin over the actuarial best estimate in its claims provisions to avoid adverse run-off deviation, which contributes to these releases.
raw_causal_phrases: predominantly in respect of Accident & Health business
margin is applied over and above the actuarial best estimate so no adverse run-off deviation is envisaged

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: The narrative text on page 20 states a "positive run off deviation of GBP 3,679k" which is a net figure and differs from the net release of GBP 5,971k shown in the Technical Provisions table on page 22. The gross prior year development figure of -GBP 5.243m is taken from the Technical Provisions table as it provides a direct breakdown of the movement. The prior year development calculated from the gross claims development triangle (-GBP 3.863m) also differs from the figure in the Technical Provisions table. The Technical Provisions table is considered the most direct source for the prior year movement.
